heading.title: Licensing of Conductors of Stage Carriages

article.title: Certain provisions of Chapter II to apply to conductor’s licence.
article.content:
36Certain provisions of Chapter II to apply to conductor’s licence.

Section 36  ·  Chapter III  ·  page 29 of the Act
The provisions of sub-section (2) of section 6, sections 14, 15 and 23, sub-section (1) of section 24 and section 25 shall, so far as may be, apply in relation to a conductor’s licence, as they apply in relation to a driving licence.
